query: I went to a local pastry shop this morning and tried their new matcha croissant, it was so flaky and the filling wasn’t too sweet at all, I even bought an extra one to save for tomorrow’s breakfast. The weather here is also surprisingly nice, sunny but not too hot, I walked around the nearby park for half an hour after eating and saw a lot of families having picnics on the lawn. I also just picked up a new phone case from the little accessory stall by the park entrance, it has little sunflower prints on it and fits my phone perfectly. I’ve been having some issues with my phone lately, none of my apps are able to save any new data or access the files I already have stored, I got a pop up saying the SIM card isn’t detected even though I didn’t take it out, and I’m traveling abroad right now with roaming turned off so I can’t get any calls or mobile data to work.
